description: Implementation of mDNS client functionality, including socket handling, packet processing, cache management, and listener/transaction management within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: MDnsConnection
classes.description: Manages UDP socket connections for mDNS, including socket creation, sending, receiving, and error handling.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl
classes.description: Implements the core mDNS client logic, including socket initialization, query handling, packet parsing, cache management, and listener/transaction coordination.

classes.name: MDnsListenerImpl
classes.description: Represents a listener for mDNS responses, managing record updates and refresh scheduling.

classes.name: MDnsTransactionImpl
classes.description: Handles mDNS query transactions, including cache queries, network queries, and callback invocation.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core
classes.description: Internal class managing cache, listeners, and packet processing within MDnsClientImpl.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::ListenerKey
classes.description: Key used to identify listeners based on name and type.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::Send
methods.description: Sends data over all active sockets.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::PostOnError
methods.description: Handles socket errors and delegates error handling.

methods.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::SendQuery
methods.description: Constructs and sends an mDNS query for a given RR type and name.

methods.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::HandlePacket
methods.description: Parses incoming mDNS packets, updates cache, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::NotifyNsecRecord
methods.description: Processes NSEC records to update cache and notify listeners of non-existent records.

methods.name: MDnsListenerImpl::ScheduleNextRefresh
methods.description: Schedules refresh at 85% and 95% TTL intervals.

methods.name: MDnsTransactionImpl::Start
methods.description: Begins a transaction, querying cache and/or network.
